subject: Private offer: listing support credit, egress cap and channel retention plan
messages:
From: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@acmehealth.com>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer questions — support credit phasing, listing fee offset & channel margin

Hi Dev,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to follow up on a few pricing mechanics we need clarity on before we can issue a PO for the private offer: 

- Support credit: can Redwood amortize the $120k support credit over 12 months (monthly credit against invoice) rather than taking it up-front?
- AWS listing fee offset: can the marketplace listing fee (one-time) be applied as a prepayment credit to month 1 rather than invoiced separately?
- Channel margin / distributor passback: Acme works with a regional distributor in EMEA. We need the distributor netback to be visible in the waterfall and ideally a passback mechanism documented in the PO (we expect ~10% of net revenue).
- Clawback: if actual usage falls below the committed floor in Q1, what's the clawback window and calculation?

We have a procurement timeline: target PO submission by 20 June. Can you send a short mutual action plan + a pricing waterfall we can present to legal and finance?

Attaching a short list of the accounting constraints from our side. Appreciate a proposal with the items above called out explicitly.

Thanks,
Maya Gupta
Head of Procurement — Acme Health
maya.gupta@acmehealth.com
Acme Health

[Attachment: acme_procurement_constraints.pdf]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — support credit phasing, listing fee offset & channel margin

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Short answers and proposed approach below; attaching a draft waterfall + MOU for review.

Support credit
- We can amortize the $120k support credit across 12 monthly invoices (i.e., $10k credit / month). This keeps your month-over-month run rate predictable for finance.

AWS listing fee offset
- We can apply the one-time AWS listing fee as a prepayment credit in month 1 of the private offer instead of issuing a separate invoice. We'll show the offset line in the waterfall.

Distributor passback (channel margin)
- We propose codifying a distributor passback at 10% of Redwood net revenue in the US by default. For EMEA we will propose a regional percentage in the updated waterfall (Irene, see note below). The passback will be reflected as a monetary credit to your distributor on Redwood's reconciliation.

Clawback
- Proposal: 6‑month clawback window measured on a rolling basis. If Q1 usage < 80% of committed floor, the clawback equals the prorated portion of the support credit tied to the shortfall. We'll spell out the exact math in the MOU.

Next steps / MAP
- I attached: redwood-pricing-waterfall.xlsx and draft-mou-acme-redwood.docx.
- If that looks fine we can update the waterfall with region-specific passback rates and produce a final MOU for signatures.
- Ask: please confirm PO target (you mentioned Jun 20) and who on your side will own the distributor evidence (invoice/settlement) requirement.

cc: Ben — anything you'd add on channel/tax treatment?

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachments: redwood-pricing-waterfall.xlsx, draft-mou-acme-redwood.docx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — quick channel notes

Quick internal notes — agree with Dev's baseline. A couple of additions before we finalize the waterfall:

- Region sensitivity: make distributor passback configurable by region. US = 10% net; EMEA = 8% net by default (EU tax/tariff frictions reduce gross passback).
- Egress / network fees: ask to cap egress exposure for first 90 days (customer worry). Propose $0.02/GB cap for months 1–3, then measured egress afterwards.
- Evidence: require distributor to provide settlement receipts quarterly; allow Acme to nominate the distributor contact in the MOU.

Irene — if you see any tax or procurement red flags for EMEA, flag them here; otherwise happy to ship as soon as Maya confirms PO timeline.

Ben Carter
Head of Channel Deals, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

[One-line internal comment: this structure keeps economic levers simple and avoids multi-line rebate waterfalls in the PO.]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Maya Gupta <maya.gupta@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer questions — listing support credit, egress cap and channel retention plan

Hi Maya — circling back with an updated proposal after internal review (see summary and attachments).

Updated proposal (high level)
- Support credit: $120k amortized over 12 months ($10k monthly credit applied to invoice).
- AWS listing fee: applied as prepayment credit in month 1 (appears as an offset line in month 1 of waterfall).
- Distributor passback: US 10% net revenue; EMEA 8% net revenue (configurable by region at time of PO).
- Clawback: 6‑month lookback; shortfall below 80% of committed floor triggers prorated clawback of support credit.
- Egress cap: $0.02/GB cap for first 90 days post-go-live, then billed at measured egress rates.

Attachments included: redwood-pricing-waterfall.xlsx (region tabs included), acme_support_credit_proposal.pdf (amortization schedule), draft-mou-acme-redwood.docx (MOU with distributor evidence clause).

If this aligns, can you confirm:
1) Procurement owner who will sign the PO, and
2) Confirmation of PO target date (we have Jun 20 noted).

Once you confirm those two items we will generate a PO-ready private offer and MOU for signatures. Happy to hop on a short call if you want to run the waterfall with finance/legal.

Thanks and talk soon,
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachments: acme_support_credit_proposal.pdf, redwood-pricing-waterfall.xlsx, draft-mou-acme-redwood.docx]
